principle: OBSERVE -> RECALL -> RESEARCH_IF_NEEDED -> PRIORITIZE -> DELEGATE -> EXECUTE_SAFE -> VERIFY -> REMEMBER

tasks.title: System health watch
tasks.prompt: Inspect local Machine AI, git state, queue health and runtime evidence. Surface outages and unsafe states. Do not modify production.

tasks.title: Checkout and order safety review
tasks.prompt: Review available local evidence for cart, checkout, order creation and payment-state risks. Do not trigger real payments, refunds or production writes.

tasks.title: Storefront read-only audit
tasks.prompt: Assess public storefront availability, broken links, navigation, product presentation and obvious customer-facing failures using read-only evidence. Never log in or submit checkout.

tasks.title: Local engineering quality audit
tasks.prompt: Run configured safe local quality checks, analyze failures and produce a repair plan. Do not deploy or mutate production data.

tasks.title: Product and fashion trend research
tasks.prompt: Research current product and streetwear opportunities. Score demand, margin potential, competition, shipping complexity, regulatory risk and originality. Research only; do not publish or purchase.

tasks.title: Supplier and landed-cost research
queries: India wholesale apparel suppliers streetwear blank t shirts
India ecommerce suppliers low MOQ trending products
tasks.prompt: Research potential suppliers, pricing signals, MOQ, shipping and reliability evidence. Never invent stock or price. Never contact or contract suppliers automatically.

tasks.title: Competitor SEO and conversion research
queries: India D2C streetwear ecommerce SEO trends 2026
tasks.prompt: Study current competitors, SEO patterns, merchandising, content and conversion opportunities. Produce testable ideas, not copied creative assets.

tasks.title: CEO morning operating plan
tasks.prompt: Use memory, recent reports and fresh research where needed to create today's highest-impact plan. Prioritize P0 then P1 then P2, then growth.

tasks.title: Growth and merchandising review
tasks.prompt: Review product, marketing, sales and merchandising opportunities from evidence. Recommend reversible experiments and drafts. Never spend ad money or publish without approval.

tasks.title: Memory consolidation and learning
tasks.prompt: Review recent episodic and semantic memory. Identify repeated failures, durable lessons, stale assumptions and decisions worth retaining. Never store credentials or private keys.

tasks.title: Weekly CEO strategy review
queries: India ecommerce market news this week
India fashion ecommerce trends this week
India social commerce trends this week
tasks.prompt: Create a weekly strategy review using local results plus fresh market evidence. Rank opportunities by impact, confidence, risk and effort.
